title: Bad Mental Conduct (2nd)
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.248 Numbered Discourses 5.248
  • 25. Duccaritavagga 25. Bad Conduct

Dutiyamanoduccaritasutta Bad Mental Conduct (2nd)

“Pañcime, bhikkhave, ādīnavā manoduccarite …pe… ānisaṁsā manosucarite. “Mendicants, there are these five drawbacks in bad mental conduct … benefits in good mental conduct …” Katame pañca? Attāpi attānaṁ na upavadati; anuvicca viññū pasaṁsanti; kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati; asaddhammā vuṭṭhāti; saddhamme patiṭṭhāti. Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṁsā manosucarite”ti.

Aṭṭhamaṁ.
